reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch concede Cain's settlement in Nod is surprising, but hold grace softened the ground's curse enough for him to survive there by hard toil.

sides.snippet: You shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.
sides.verseText: From now on, when you till the ground, it won't yield its strength to you. You shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.\"

sides.snippet: He built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
sides.verseText: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
